notes.title: Pale Light: a free game from Hushberry, coming later this year...
notes.content: [p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312620/Pale_Light/?curator_clanid=45671555"]Pale Light[/url], a short, free visual novel + puzzle game, will be coming out this year in time for Halloween![/p][p]The game was [i]intended[/i] for Halloween last year, but some last-minute hiccups prevented its release. The good news is, since it's already basically done, it will take very little development time away from Hushberry's other pursuits![/p][p]If you're up for some pixelated spookiness (and, though our protagonist is not into dead people [i]that[/i] way, a few pixelated nipples), [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312620/Pale_Light/?curator_clanid=45671555"]consider wishlisting it[/url]![/p][p]Have fun! ;)[/p]

notes.title: Gallery feature, and early Chat History feature
notes.content:
One Possible Future has gained two features:

1. A gallery of unlockable images, accessible from the title menu. Images are unlocked as they're discovered in the game.
2. A first pass at a chat history feature. It's currently accessible only via the hamburger menu when exploring, NOT during conversations, which is obviously less than ideal! Larger UI changes will be needed to improve this.

These improvements will almost certainly be making their way into [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2859130/For_One_Year/]For One Year[/url], as well :)

Thanks for playing, and have fun ;)

notes.title: One Possible Future has been released... here's what you can expect, next!
notes.content:
One Possible Future is now available on Steam! I'm delighted to share this bizarre vision of a possible sci-fi future, and I hope you have some fun with it ;)

So what's next for Hushberry Games?

[olist]
[*] Expect some quality-of-life releases for One Possible Future. For example, a chat history (in case you clicked too fast and missed some lines of dialog) is coming soon!
[*] For One Year - Hushberry Game's first release - hasn't received an update in a long time, in part because of One Possible Future! If you enjoy One Possible Future, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2859130/For_One_Year/]give For One Year a look[/url]! It's a little different, with rogue-like and survival elements, but absolutely shares some DNA with One Possible Future (including native support for bluetooth-enabled toys).
[*] More games are coming! It's hard to say when, or in what form, but One Possible Future will not be the last thing Hushberry Games releases!
[/olist]

Have fun, and thanks for playing One Possible Future :)
